register: Specialist media and technology usage; curar contenidos is established in Spain for selecting, organising and contextualising material.
trap: Curar normally means heal or cure, while conservar is preserve; in media, curar contenidos is the established specialist extension.
example_tl: Los editores curan contenidos de múltiples fuentes, pero siguen respondiendo de la jerarquía narrativa y de la verificación de cada enlace.
example_en: Editors curate content from multiple sources, but they remain responsible for the narrative hierarchy and for verifying every link.
cloze: Los editores {{c1::curan contenidos}} de múltiples fuentes, pero siguen respondiendo de la jerarquía narrativa y de la verificación de cada enlace.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which gives conservar and misses the media-specific sense. Self-review: retained contenidos in the headword because bare curar does not reliably signal this usage.

register: Neutral technical usage; incrustar is especially precise for placing media or code directly inside a webpage or digital document.
trap: Integrar is broader than embed, and insertar does not necessarily imply that the content runs or remains inside the host page.
example_tl: La redacción incrustó el vídeo original en la investigación interactiva para que los lectores pudieran revisar la evidencia sin abandonar la página.
example_en: The newsroom embedded the original video in the interactive investigation so that readers could review the evidence without leaving the page.
cloze: La redacción {{c1::incrustó}} el vídeo original en la investigación interactiva para que los lectores pudieran revisar la evidencia sin abandonar la página.
note: The old gloss integrar is possible in a broad product sense, but incrustar is the sharper web-development rendering for the example.

register: Neutral technical and institutional usage; interactuar con describes systems, organisations or actors working through a point of contact.
trap: The English verb is not normally interfazarse; interfaz is a noun, while Spanish uses interactuar con or servir de interfaz con.
example_tl: Para supervisar contratos transfronterizos, el regulador necesita interactuar con sistemas que aplican normas de privacidad incompatibles entre sí.
example_en: To oversee cross-border contracts, the regulator needs to interface with systems that apply incompatible privacy rules.
cloze: Para supervisar contratos transfronterizos, el regulador necesita {{c1::interactuar con}} sistemas que aplican normas de privacidad incompatibles entre sí.
note: Materially diverges from old_back: interconectar describes connecting things, whereas the source verb here describes a party or system interacting with another.

register: Formal analytical usage; converger en is used for distinct processes, positions or trajectories arriving at a shared point or outcome.
trap: Spanish commonly uses converger en or converger hacia; the English-like preposition a is not the default before a shared outcome.
example_tl: Aunque partan de diagnósticos distintos, las dos comisiones convergieron en una propuesta común para limitar la extracción comercial de datos personales.
example_en: Although they started from different diagnoses, the two commissions converged on a common proposal to limit the commercial extraction of personal data.
cloze: Aunque partan de diagnósticos distintos, las dos comisiones {{c1::convergieron en}} una propuesta común para limitar la extracción comercial de datos personales.
note: The legacy headword is close but omits the productive governed frame. Self-review: selected converger en because the example concerns agreement on an outcome, not merely movement towards it.

register: Neutral-formal; aprovechar is the unmarked Spanish choice for using an asset, position or resource to obtain an advantage.
trap: Apalancar is a specialised financial term, not a blanket translation of leverage in policy or media prose; para aprovechar is a purpose phrase, not the headword.
example_tl: Los medios públicos deben aprovechar sus archivos históricos sin convertirlos en una fuente opaca de entrenamiento para modelos comerciales.
example_en: Public media outlets should leverage their historical archives without turning them into an opaque source of training data for commercial models.
cloze: Los medios públicos deben {{c1::aprovechar}} sus archivos históricos sin convertirlos en una fuente opaca de entrenamiento para modelos comerciales.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing the English infinitive marker's accidental para. The example fixes the general strategic-use sense rather than the narrow financial one.

register: Formal policy and legal usage; hacer cumplir presents an authority as ensuring that a rule, law or standard is obeyed.
trap: Imponer means impose, not necessarily enforce: an authority can impose a rule without actually making compliance happen.
example_tl: La autoridad debe hacer cumplir las normas de transparencia incluso cuando los grandes anunciantes amenacen con retirar sus campañas del mercado nacional.
example_en: The authority must enforce transparency rules even when major advertisers threaten to withdraw their campaigns from the national market.
cloze: La autoridad debe {{c1::hacer cumplir}} las normas de transparencia incluso cuando los grandes anunciantes amenacen con retirar sus campañas del mercado nacional.
note: Materially corrects old_back: imponer selects the act of laying down a rule, while the source selects the subsequent duty to ensure compliance.

register: Neutral-formal policy and legal usage; restringir is common when access, rights or activity are narrowed by an explicit rule.
trap: Restringir is transitive in this sense; the reflexive restringirse means to limit oneself or to be confined, not to impose a restriction.
example_tl: El nuevo marco restringe el acceso de las plataformas a determinados datos públicos, pero mantiene excepciones para investigaciones de interés general.
example_en: The new framework restricts platforms’ access to certain government data, but it maintains exceptions for research in the public interest.
cloze: El nuevo marco {{c1::restringe}} el acceso de las plataformas a determinados datos públicos, pero mantiene excepciones para investigaciones de interés general.
note: The old gloss is a valid bare equivalent; retention is justified by the formal policy register and the useful contrast with the broader limitar.

register: Specialist data-policy usage; elaborar perfiles describes inferring a person's traits, preferences or behaviour from collected signals.
trap: Perfilar can mean outline or define a strategy, but in data protection prose elaborar perfiles makes the creation of user profiles explicit.
example_tl: Las plataformas elaboran perfiles de los usuarios a partir de señales aparentemente inocuas, desde el horario de conexión hasta la cadencia de lectura.
example_en: Platforms profile users from apparently innocuous signals, from connection times to reading cadence.
cloze: Las plataformas {{c1::elaboran perfiles}} de los usuarios a partir de señales aparentemente inocuas, desde el horario de conexión hasta la cadencia de lectura.
note: Materially sharpens old_back: perfilar is possible in some contexts, but the example targets data profiling rather than outlining a plan or silhouette.

register: Neutral technical and statistical usage; agregar datos means combining separate observations into a larger dataset or summary.
trap: Agregar can also mean add, but in data analysis the object and context distinguish aggregation from merely appending another item.
example_tl: El estudio agrega datos de movilidad y consumo para mostrar cómo la desigualdad territorial condiciona el acceso efectivo a los servicios digitales.
example_en: The study aggregates mobility and consumption data to show how territorial inequality conditions effective access to digital services.
cloze: El estudio {{c1::agrega}} datos de movilidad y consumo para mostrar cómo la desigualdad territorial condiciona el acceso efectivo a los servicios digitales.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing para. Self-review: chose agregar datos, the established statistical collocation, rather than forcing the less precise sumar.

register: Technical and critical analytical usage; ofuscar covers making code, data or an explanation deliberately difficult to understand.
trap: Ofuscar is not simply ocultar: the central idea is obscuring intelligibility or traceability, often while leaving the material technically present.
example_tl: Algunas empresas ofuscan deliberadamente el código de sus aplicaciones para dificultar auditorías independientes sobre sus prácticas de recopilación de datos.
example_en: Some companies deliberately obfuscate their application code to make independent audits of their data-collection practices more difficult.
cloze: Algunas empresas {{c1::ofuscan}} deliberadamente el código de sus aplicaciones para dificultar auditorías independientes sobre sus prácticas de recopilación de datos.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the note preserves the specialised sense rather than treating ofuscar as a generic synonym for hide.

register: Formal critical and historical usage; perpetuar usually describes keeping an injustice, hierarchy, narrative or practice in place.
trap: Perpetuar is not perpetrar: the former makes something continue indefinitely, whereas the latter means commit an offence or harmful act.
example_tl: La retórica de la excepcionalidad perpetúa políticas de vigilancia que, una vez normalizadas, resultan muy difíciles de desmontar democráticamente.
example_en: The rhetoric of exceptionalism perpetuates surveillance policies that, once normalised, prove very difficult to dismantle democratically.
cloze: La retórica de la excepcionalidad {{c1::perpetúa}} políticas de vigilancia que, una vez normalizadas, resultan muy difíciles de desmontar democráticamente.
note: The old gloss is accurate. Retention is justified by the high-value false-cognate contrast with perpetrar and the strongly evaluative policy collocation.

register: Neutral-formal for handling a complex institutional, regulatory or social environment; navegar is better reserved for literal or interface contexts.
trap: Navegar is natural for a website or boat, but English navigate a market or bureaucracy often calls for desenvolverse en or sortear in Spanish.
example_tl: Las redacciones pequeñas deben desenvolverse en un mercado dominado por plataformas que cambian sus condiciones comerciales sin previo aviso.
example_en: Small newsrooms must navigate a market dominated by platforms that change their commercial terms without warning.
cloze: Las redacciones pequeñas deben {{c1::desenvolverse en}} un mercado dominado por plataformas que cambian sus condiciones comerciales sin previo aviso.
note: The source is polysemous. This note selects the figurative institutional sense and materially diverges from old_back, which gives only the literal cognate navegar.

register: Neutral-formal diplomatic and institutional usage; mediar entre identifies an intermediary helping opposing parties reach an agreement.
trap: Spanish uses mediar entre the parties for this role; mediar con is not the normal equivalent of English mediate with someone.
example_tl: La organización medió entre el Gobierno y las familias afectadas para desbloquear una negociación que llevaba meses estancada.
example_en: The organisation mediated between the government and the affected families to unblock negotiations that had been stalled for months.
cloze: La organización {{c1::medió entre}} el Gobierno y las familias afectadas para desbloquear una negociación que llevaba meses estancada.
note: The old gloss is a valid root equivalent but omits the productive frame. Self-review: used mediar entre rather than mediar con to match standard Spanish government.

register: Formal analytical and strategic usage; concebir suggests forming a considered picture of a possible future or institutional design.
trap: Prever means foresee or predict, not envision: it focuses on anticipated likelihood rather than on a deliberately imagined possibility.
example_tl: El proyecto concibe una esfera pública digital en la que la transparencia no dependa de decisiones opacas de empresas privadas.
example_en: The project envisions a digital public sphere in which transparency does not depend on opaque decisions by private companies.
cloze: El proyecto {{c1::concibe}} una esfera pública digital en la que la transparencia no dependa de decisiones opacas de empresas privadas.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which gives prever. Self-review: selected concebir for a planned institutional vision, while reserving prever for forecasting an outcome.

register: Technical business, policy and performance-analysis usage; the phrase makes the comparison standard explicit rather than implying a casual comparison.
trap: Comparar alone does not encode benchmarking; Spanish needs a reference point, standard or peer group to express the specialised sense.
example_tl: La auditoría compara las prácticas de moderación de la plataforma con un referente europeo que publica criterios y resultados verificables.
example_en: The audit benchmarks the platform's moderation practices against a European standard that publishes verifiable criteria and results.
cloze: La auditoría {{c1::compara}} las prácticas de moderación de la plataforma {{c1::con un referente}} europeo que publica criterios y resultados verificables.
note: Materially expands old_back, which gives the underspecified comparar. The production headword supplies the benchmark's required reference point.

register: Formal critical and technical usage; eludir suggests deliberately avoiding a rule, control, obstacle or accountability mechanism.
trap: Evitar is a broad equivalent, but eludir or sortear better signals deliberate circumvention of an institutional control; puentear is specialist jargon.
example_tl: Los intermediarios intentaron eludir los controles de competencia mediante adquisiciones escalonadas y complejas estructuras societarias transfronterizas difíciles de rastrear.
example_en: The intermediaries tried to bypass competition controls through staggered acquisitions and complex cross-border corporate structures that were difficult to trace.
cloze: Los intermediarios intentaron {{c1::eludir}} los controles de competencia mediante adquisiciones escalonadas y complejas estructuras societarias transfronterizas difíciles de rastrear.
note: Materially sharpens old_back: evitar is possible but too general for the deliberate circumvention sense fixed by the regulatory example.

register: Written-formal academic, journalistic and legal usage; dilucidar means clarify a difficult question through analysis or evidence.
trap: Dilucidar is transitive and means clarify or resolve a question; it is not a purpose phrase beginning with para, as the old gloss suggests.
example_tl: El informe dilucida qué mecanismos permitieron que una campaña coordinada alterase el debate público sin dejar una huella financiera evidente.
example_en: The report elucidates which mechanisms allowed a coordinated campaign to alter public debate without leaving an evident financial trail.
cloze: El informe {{c1::dilucida}} qué mecanismos permitieron que una campaña coordinada alterase el debate público sin dejar una huella financiera evidente.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing para. Self-review: used a direct interrogative clause after dilucidar, a natural formal construction in Spanish investigative prose.

register: Neutral-formal critical usage; erosionar works for the gradual weakening of trust, legitimacy, rights or institutional capacity.
trap: Erosionar is fully idiomatic for abstract effects in Spanish; it is not restricted to physical wear and need not be replaced by the stronger socavar.
example_tl: La opacidad erosiona la confianza ciudadana cuando las instituciones publican cifras sin explicar los criterios empleados para producirlas.
example_en: Opacity erodes public trust when institutions publish figures without explaining the criteria used to produce them.
cloze: La opacidad {{c1::erosiona}} la confianza ciudadana cuando las instituciones publican cifras sin explicar los criterios empleados para producirlas.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the productive metaphorical collocation and the distinction between gradual erosion and sharper undermining.

register: Neutral media and service usage; suscribirse a is standard for joining a publication, newsletter or paid service.
trap: Suscribir without the reflexive marker means sign or endorse something; subscribing to a service requires suscribirse a, while abonarse a is more service-oriented.
example_tl: Miles de lectores se suscribieron a la revista para recibir investigaciones que los medios generalistas habían dejado fuera de agenda.
example_en: Thousands of readers subscribed to the magazine to receive investigations that mainstream media had left off the agenda.
cloze: Miles de lectores {{c1::se suscribieron a}} la revista para recibir investigaciones que los medios generalistas habían dejado fuera de agenda.
note: Materially expands old_back with the reflexive marker and preposition. The source is polysemous; this note selects the publication or service sense.

register: Neutral-formal academic, statistical and policy usage; cuantificar expresses measuring an amount or effect numerically.
trap: Cuantificar is not merely contar: it assigns a measurable magnitude or value, including to an abstract effect such as democratic cost.
example_tl: La investigación cuantifica el coste democrático de la desinformación sin reducir sus efectos a una sola métrica de audiencia.
example_en: The research quantifies the democratic cost of disinformation without reducing its effects to a single audience metric.
cloze: La investigación {{c1::cuantifica}} el coste democrático de la desinformación sin reducir sus efectos a una sola métrica de audiencia.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the academic register and the distinction between assigning magnitude and simply counting items.

register: Formal diplomatic, geopolitical and legal usage; tomar represalias describes a deliberate punitive response to another actor's action.
trap: Vengarse is more personal and emotional; retaliate in interstate or institutional prose normally calls for tomar represalias or responder con medidas.
example_tl: El Gobierno amenazó con tomar represalias comerciales si la empresa extranjera divulgaba documentos que comprometían a sus aliados estratégicos.
example_en: The government threatened to retaliate commercially if the foreign company disclosed documents that implicated its strategic allies.
cloze: El Gobierno amenazó con {{c1::tomar represalias}} comerciales si la empresa extranjera divulgaba documentos que comprometían a sus aliados estratégicos.
note: Materially corrects old_back with the idiomatic fixed expression. Self-review: kept the commercial modifier outside the cloze because it specifies the type of retaliation, not the verb phrase.

register: Neutral-formal political, institutional and media usage; respaldar signals public support for a proposal, position or person.
trap: Endosar is mainly used for transferring or guaranteeing a financial instrument; it is not the neutral Spanish verb for endorsing a policy.
example_tl: La mayoría parlamentaria respaldó la propuesta, aunque varios diputados advirtieron que el texto podía debilitar la supervisión judicial.
example_en: The parliamentary majority endorsed the proposal, although several MPs warned that the text could weaken judicial oversight.
cloze: La mayoría parlamentaria {{c1::respaldó}} la propuesta, aunque varios diputados advirtieron que el texto podía debilitar la supervisión judicial.
note: The old gloss avalar is a valid alternative for a proposal, but respaldar is the broadest production-ready headword; the alternatives are limited to genuine support senses.

register: Neutral technical and cybersecurity usage; autenticar confirms that a user, device or document is genuinely what it claims to be.
trap: Autenticar is not authorise: authentication establishes identity or authenticity, while authorisation determines which actions or resources are permitted.
example_tl: El sistema autentica a cada usuario antes de permitirle consultar expedientes sensibles, pero no determina qué permisos debe concederle después.
example_en: The system authenticates each user before allowing them to consult sensitive files, but it does not determine which permissions to grant afterwards.
cloze: El sistema {{c1::autentica}} a cada usuario antes de permitirle consultar expedientes sensibles, pero no determina qué permisos debe concederle después.
note: Autentificar in old_back is possible, but autenticar is the concise standard technical headword here. Self-review: made the authentication/authorisation distinction explicit in the example.

register: Formal economic usage; devaluar normally describes an intentional reduction in a currency's official value, while depreciar is broader.
trap: Desvalorizar is not the standard monetary choice in European Spanish; depreciar often describes market decline, whereas devaluar implies an official decision.
example_tl: El Gobierno devaluó la moneda después de que los mercados perdieran confianza en la capacidad fiscal del Estado que la respaldaba.
example_en: The government devalued the currency after markets lost confidence in the fiscal capacity of the state backing it.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::devaluó}} la moneda después de que los mercados perdieran confianza en la capacidad fiscal del Estado que la respaldaba.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which uses a nonstandard or nonmonetary-looking rendering. Self-review: fixed the example to the deliberate official-currency sense that distinguishes devaluar from depreciar.

register: Neutral-formal policy, management and analytical usage; priorizar is standard in Spain for ranking objectives or actions by importance.
trap: Priorizar normally takes a direct object, while the equally natural dar prioridad a requires the preposition a; do not combine the two frames.
example_tl: La estrategia prioriza la alfabetización mediática porque una ciudadanía informada resulta más resistente a campañas coordinadas de manipulación política.
example_en: The strategy prioritizes media literacy because an informed public is more resistant to coordinated political-manipulation campaigns.
cloze: La estrategia {{c1::prioriza}} la alfabetización mediática porque una ciudadanía informada resulta más resistente a campañas coordinadas de manipulación política.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the productive contrast between the direct verb and the governed frame dar prioridad a in policy prose.
